description: The lists, the effective-recipe table, the refusal order and every sentence mapper/v1/mapper.py and ophiolite-mapper apply (E116). Any change to a list or a sentence changes rules_version; the same rules_version gives the same verdict wherever the validator runs. 1.2.0 (E116 s2): the identity decision, the targets that need it, a folder of LAS files and the merge of rows of a table of wells. 1.3.0 (E116 s4): how a workbook is read (reading, decided like a declaration), a previously reviewed column applied only when prefilled (reuse, apply), bucket prefixes, the reviewed file's refusal and a manifest that fails its own checks. 1.4.0 (E169 s0): an exported bundle as a source and OSDU records as its target (bundle), the manifest verb's own refusal order after source-changed (manifest_refusal_order), the reasons an asset is left unwritten (unwritten; revision-repeated leaves every revision of an asset the bundle holds more than once unwritten, never one picked), and the closed lists those sentences fill in (bundle_unreadable, association_things). 1.5.0 (E169 s1): curve-text-unwritable leaves unwritten a log whose curve name or unit a LAS 2.0 header line cannot carry.

bundle_unreadable.not-a-bundle: it is not a project exported from Ophiolite
bundle_unreadable.major-version: it was exported in a format this version does not read
bundle_unreadable.size: it is larger than this version reads
bundle_unreadable.link: it holds a link to a file elsewhere
bundle_unreadable.checksum: one of its files does not match the checksum the bundle lists for it

words.not-yet-inspect: ophiolite-mapper cannot inspect sources yet in this version. Nothing was read or written.
words.not-yet-write: ophiolite-mapper cannot write project folders yet in this version. Nothing was read or written.
words.recipe-missing: There is no recipe at the path given. Run inspect first, then review the recipe it writes.
words.recipe-outdated: This recipe was made with rules {explanation}; run inspect again with the keep-decisions option to carry its decisions over. Nothing was written.
words.recipe-invalid: The recipe cannot be used: one entry is not as the recipe format describes. The technical details say which.
words.source-changed: The source has changed since the recipe was written. Run inspect again and review the recipe.
words.field-undecided: {field} was only suggested from the column names. Accept, choose or leave it unmapped in the recipe before writing.
words.layout-undecided: The layout of the source was only suggested. Accept or reject it in the recipe before writing.
words.alias-undecided: The well name {spelling} only resembles {canonical}. Accept or reject the match in the recipe before writing.
words.identity-undecided: How the wells are told apart was only proposed: {explanation}. Accept it in the recipe, or change it, before writing.
words.mapping-incomplete: The recipe cannot be written as it stands: {explanation} Change the recipe and try again.
words.alias-conflict: The well name {spelling} cannot join {canonical}: their {field} differs, {explanation}. Correct the source, or reject the match in the recipe.
words.finding-unacknowledged: {explanation} Fix the source, or acknowledge in the recipe that these rows are left out.
words.reading-undecided: How to read the workbook is not settled yet: {explanation} State it in the recipe, or accept the guess, before writing.
words.manifest-invalid: The OSDU manifest made from this recipe does not pass its own checks ({explanation}), so nothing was written. The technical details say where.
words.target-needed: Say which kind of data the table holds with the target option; this version reads tables of wells only. Nothing was read or written.
words.target-unavailable: This version reads tables of wells only, so it cannot read a table as {target}. Nothing was read or written.
words.format-unavailable: This version reads text tables with separated columns and Excel workbooks only; OpenDocument spreadsheets, database tables and a single file in a bucket come later. Save the sheet as a text table or an Excel workbook and inspect that. Nothing was written.
words.reader-missing: Reading LAS files needs the las extra: pip install 'ophiolite-mapper[las]'. Nothing was read or written.
words.reading-unavailable: Reading Excel workbooks needs the spreadsheets extra: pip install 'ophiolite-mapper[spreadsheets]'. Nothing was read or written.
words.folder-unsupported: The folder {path} cannot be read as a set of well logs: {explanation} Nothing was read or written.
words.bucket-keys-missing: Reading a bucket needs its access key and secret in the environment variables AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Nothing was read or written.
words.bucket-destination-refused: This storage address is not allowed. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-unreachable: This storage cannot be reached. Try again later. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-tls-refused: This storage's certificate could not be trusted. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-sign-in-refused: The storage refused this key. Check the access key and secret. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-no-list-right: This key cannot list files. Ask for permission to list. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-bucket-missing: This storage has no bucket with that name. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-wrong-region: This storage expects a different region. Name its region with the region option. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-object-missing: A file is no longer under the prefix; this does not confirm it was deleted. Run inspect again. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-object-changed: A file under the prefix changed while it was read. Run inspect again. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-throttled: This storage is busy. Try again shortly. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-unreadable: This storage answered in a way ophiolite-mapper could not read. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-no-consistent-read: This storage cannot read large files safely, so these files cannot be read. Nothing was written.
words.bucket-unsupported: The bucket prefix {path} cannot be read as a set of well logs: {explanation} Nothing was read or written.
words.reviewed-unreadable: The file of earlier column choices at {path} cannot be read. Move it aside, or run again with the option that leaves it out. Nothing was written.
words.source-unreadable: The source cannot be read. {explanation} Nothing was written.
words.recipe-exists: There is a recipe at {path} already. Move it aside, or inspect again with the force option to replace it. Nothing was written.
words.out-unavailable: The project folder cannot be made at {path}. Name a folder that does not exist yet, inside a folder you can write to. Nothing was written.
words.inspect-written: The recipe is written to {path}. Review it, then run write to make the project folder.
words.not-yet-manifest: ophiolite-mapper cannot write OSDU records from an exported bundle yet in this version. Nothing was read or written.
words.not-yet-bundle: ophiolite-mapper recognised an exported bundle but cannot inspect one yet in this version. Nothing was written.
words.bundle-unreadable: The exported bundle at {path} could not be read: {why}. Nothing was written.
words.bundle-is-folder: This is a project folder, not an exported project. Its manifest is written by write.
words.bundle-without-wells: This bundle carries no wells and wellbores, so its logs cannot be placed. Export the project again with its wells.
words.association-ambiguous: The {thing} {name} is associated with more than one {target} in this bundle. Nothing was written.
words.association-missing: The log {name} is not associated with one wellbore in this bundle. Associate it in Ophiolite and export again, or export without it. Nothing was written.
words.wellbore-without-well: The wellbore {name} belongs to no well in this bundle. Nothing was written.
words.profile-without-kind: This version cannot export this data as OSDU records.
words.profile-not-listed: This version cannot export this data as OSDU records.
words.kind-not-written: This version does not write this kind of OSDU record yet.
words.curves-on-different-axes: The curves of this log are not on one depth axis, so one LAS file cannot hold them.
words.revision-repeated: This bundle holds more than one version of this data. Export one version to write it.
words.curve-text-unwritable: A curve name or unit of this log cannot be written in a LAS header line. Rename it in Ophiolite to export it.
